name: Chrome for screenshots
description: An installed Chrome or Chromium that headless capture scripts drive through playwright-core.

spec.summary: The browser the capture scripts drive. playwright-core never downloads one: it uses the one installed here.

params.label: Chrome executable
params.description: A command on PATH (google-chrome, chromium) or the absolute path of the executable.

instructions.*: Install Google Chrome or Chromium, then enter the executable: a command on your `PATH` or its absolute path. Press **Check**.
instructions.linux: Install Google Chrome (https://www.google.com/chrome/) or Chromium from your distribution. Enter `google-chrome`, `google-chrome-stable` or `chromium` — whichever `command -v` finds — and press **Check**.
instructions.darwin:
Install Google Chrome from https://www.google.com/chrome/ and enter:

```
/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome
```

Then press **Check**.
instructions.windows:
Install Google Chrome and enter its path, usually:

```
C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe
```

Then press **Check**.
